chapter: New Orleans musicians, recordings and radio
title: Louis Armstrong as an overgrown kid; Lil Hardin and Louis start seeing each other
summary: Louis was sweet, played with all his heart and was loved by everyone; she barely noticed Lil and Louis getting together.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What was Louie like in those days?

Just like a great big overgrown kid. He was just as sweet and nice as he could be, nice and kind and loved his music. He loved his music. In fact, I thought he did because he used to just play -- Louie used to just play with all the heart he had. You could see he enjoyed what he was doing, you know, and he was loved by everybody.
The minute he came up there, people took to him, you know, and he was very friendly with everybody.
Yes, and you remember when Lil and Louie started.
Yeah, well, she was Lil Harding.
She was Lil Harding at the time.
Do you remember when they started seeing each other and --
Yes, uh-huh, they started seeing each other. But I -- you see, I didn't -- as I say, I just was -- just there singing; I didn't get around much.
